entries.4bfe9477192d525d: TAMAI STEAMSHIP CO., LTD. is a shipping company founded in 1929 in Kobe, with its head office in Minato-ku, Tokyo. The company and its three consolidated subsidiaries form a group, with 61 employees (as of March 31, 2026).

entries.72db4534f1351606: The ocean shipping business is built on medium- to long-term transportation contracts with major customers with whom it has built trusting relationships over many years. The coastal shipping business is characterized by a structure that leverages the strengths of its consolidated subsidiary Daiyon Marine Co., Ltd., which holds young seafarers with an average age of 33, and provides seafarer dispatch by systematically hiring and training young seafarers.

entries.f45bd257c2777bfb: Based on the medium-term management plan formulated in July 2024 (fiscal years ended March 2025 to March 2027), the company states that in ocean shipping it aims to stabilize and maximize revenue by optimizing existing cargo, routes and vessels, and will pursue efficient vessel deployment by securing long-term contracts and shortening ballast voyages. In coastal shipping, it aims to improve revenue by optimizing contract rates and contract periods, and to expand the business by increasing the number of seafarers and managed vessels. In its investment strategy, it states that while securing a financial position able to withstand changes in shipping market conditions and the business environment, it will continue reinvesting in its core ocean and coastal shipping businesses.
